title: A Nested Contributor is a single company that is simultaneously a core contributor to an Agent and to Sky itself
content:
A.6.1.1.2.2.1.1.3.1.1.5 introduces a category with a precise definition: "Grove Development Company is a 'Nested Contributor', i.e., a core contributor to both Grove and Sky."

The term matters because Agents in the Sky ecosystem are deliberately semi-autonomous — they have their own token, their own governance and their own Artifact. A contributor that sits inside only the Agent has one principal. A Nested Contributor has two, and those two can diverge: what maximizes Grove's returns is not automatically what protects Sky's balance sheet.

Naming the status is itself a control. By declaring the dual allegiance in the Artifact rather than leaving it implicit, the Atlas makes the conflict inspectable — reviewers know in advance which entity's incentives span both layers, instead of discovering it during an incident.

The trade-off being accepted is deliberate: nesting buys tight alignment and shared context between an Agent and its parent ecosystem at the cost of a permanent, structural conflict of interest that must be managed by process rather than eliminated.
description: Grove Development Company holds this dual status while providing services to the Grove Foundation, placing one organization inside two accountability structures at the same time.
